title: Biryani and Wensleydale Stir Fry
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and British flavors, this stir fry combines the nutty flavor of biryani with the creamy taste of Wensleydale cheese.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the Chinese broccoli and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the red chili and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the biryani and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the Wensleydale cheese and stir-fry until melted and bubbly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
